rubric.criterion: The first viewport explains the trigger, action, outcome, and trial CTA without scrolling.
A product-specific comment-to-DM artifact demonstrates the workflow using visible states.
The visual system has committed color, recognizable type hierarchy, and a memorable product motif without copied assets.
Pricing, trial terms, official API status, limits, and one primary action are easy to find.
Interaction feedback and motion explain state change and include a reduced-motion equivalent.
The buyer path works without clipping or horizontal overflow at 390, 768, and 1440 pixel widths.
Semantic headings, visible focus, labels, touch targets, and WCAG AA text contrast are present.
